summary: Minimal, precise defense-in-depth fix. The try/except Exception wrapping in backtest/__init__.py correctly preserves all 4 acceptance criteria in both success and failure paths. All 148 existing backtest/jax_compat/cpu_engine/gpu_engine tests pass; manual failure-mode simulation (AttributeError from get_gpu_backtest_engine_class) confirms CPUBacktestEngine remains importable and GPUBacktestEngine is None. Spec compliance: the implementer chose the 'alternative simpler approach' which the task spec explicitly allows.

ac1_cpu_import_works.evidence: CPUBacktestEngine is imported at the top of __init__.py before the try/except. Manually verified: patching get_gpu_backtest_engine_class to raise AttributeError and re-importing the package, CPUBacktestEngine remains importable. Existing test test_cpu_engine_import_without_jax also passes.

ac2_gpu_engine_none_on_failure.evidence: except Exception block sets GPUBacktestEngine = None. Manual simulation with AttributeError, RuntimeError, and other exceptions all yield None. Importantly, KeyboardInterrupt (a BaseException) is NOT caught and correctly propagates, preserving user Ctrl+C semantics.

ac3_gpu_engine_real_class.evidence: When get_gpu_backtest_engine_class() succeeds, the assignment works unchanged. Verified: in the dev environment, GPUBacktestEngine is the real class (type) and __all__ includes it.

ac4_all_conditional.evidence: The if GPUBacktestEngine is not None: __all__.append('GPUBacktestEngine') guard is unchanged from the original. Verified in both success and failure paths.

edge_cases.keyboard_interrupt_propagates: PASS - 'except Exception' does not catch BaseException subclasses (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit). Confirmed by direct call test.
edge_cases.memory_error: Caught (MemoryError is a subclass of Exception). Acceptable for module-import time; consequence is just GPUBacktestEngine = None, which is the desired fallback.
edge_cases.syntax_error: Caught (SyntaxError is a subclass of Exception). Unlikely at module level but safe; would still allow import to succeed with GPU disabled.
edge_cases.multiple_consecutive_imports: PASS - if the package is reloaded (e.g., in tests), the try/except runs each time. No cached state issues.

security.broad_exception_handling: INFO - 'except Exception' is broad by design (defense-in-depth). It does NOT mask BaseException, so intentional user/system signals still propagate. No security concern: the only consequence of catching is GPUBacktestEngine = None, which is a benign degraded state.
security.no_user_input: PASS - No user input is processed at module level.
security.no_secrets: PASS - No credentials or tokens involved.
security.no_subprocess_or_fs: PASS - No shell, file, or network operations at module level.

maintainability.minimal_change: PASS - 4 insertions, 1 deletion in a single file. The diff is exactly the 'alternative simpler approach' from the spec.
maintainability.import_order: PASS - CPUBacktestEngine and jax_compat imports at top remain unchanged; the try/except only wraps the single eager call.
maintainability.code_clarity: PASS - The intent is clear without comments: 'try to detect GPU engine; if anything goes wrong, fall back to None'. No docstring changes needed.
maintainability.scope_discipline: PASS - Only gpu_fuzzy_trader/backtest/__init__.py modified. No drive-by changes to other files.

test_adequacy.existing_tests_pass: PASS - All 3 tests in test_jax_compat.py pass; all 90 tests in test_cpu_engine.py and test_jax_compat.py pass; all 148 tests across test_jax_compat/test_cpu_engine/test_gpu_engine pass.
test_adequacy.new_path_covered: INFO - None of the existing tests directly exercise the new try/except path. They all patch get_gpu_backtest_engine_class to return None (successful path). A regression test that patches it to raise an unexpected exception (e.g., AttributeError) and verifies the package still imports would lock in the defense-in-depth contract. This is a nice-to-have, not blocking, because (a) the existing tests cover the end-to-end behavior, and (b) the logic is trivial and visually verifiable.
test_adequacy.test_jax_compat_staleness: INFO - The current test file on this branch still has the old test name 'test_get_gpu_backtest_engine_class_returns_none_on_runtime_error' (not the '_on_import_error' that the task-1 handoff claims). This is a task-1 follow-up, not a task-2 issue.

manual_verification_performed: Imported backtest package after patching get_gpu_backtest_engine_class to raise AttributeError: package imports cleanly, CPUBacktestEngine available, GPUBacktestEngine is None, __all__ excludes GPUBacktestEngine.
Verified normal success path: GPUBacktestEngine is the real class and is in __all__.
Verified KeyboardInterrupt propagates correctly (not swallowed by except Exception).
Ran full test_jax_compat.py + test_cpu_engine.py + test_gpu_engine.py suite: 148/148 pass.

findings.description: No regression test directly exercises the new try/except path. Existing tests in test_jax_compat.py all patch get_gpu_backtest_engine_class to return None (the success path of the new try/except), so the new defense-in-depth block is never actually entered by the test suite.
findings.evidence: tests/unit/test_jax_compat.py test_cpu_engine_import_without_jax uses monkeypatch.setattr(jc, 'get_gpu_backtest_engine_class', lambda: None) — no exception is ever raised during the patched call.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add a test that patches get_gpu_backtest_engine_class to raise an unexpected exception (e.g., AttributeError) and asserts that 'from gpu_fuzzy_trader.backtest import CPUBacktestEngine' still works. Example: monkeypatch.setattr(jc, 'get_gpu_backtest_engine_class', lambda: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AttributeError('test'))).

findings.description: The except block silently sets GPUBacktestEngine = None without logging the cause. If a future change causes get_gpu_backtest_engine_class to raise an unexpected exception (the defense-in-depth scenario this PR guards against), there will be no diagnostic trail in the logs explaining why GPU is unavailable.
findings.evidence: backtest/__init__.py lines 16-18: bare 'except Exception: GPUBacktestEngine = None' with no log call.
findings.fix_suggestion: Optional: 'import logging; logger = logging.getLogger(__name__); ... except Exception as exc: logger.warning("GPU backtest engine detection failed unexpectedly (%s: %s); falling back to CPU.", type(exc).__name__, exc); GPUBacktestEngine = None'.

checks_performed.security_review: PASS (no user input, no secrets, no subprocess, broad exception is appropriate for module-level defense-in-depth)
